The Fairwork Cloudwork Ratings are published by the [Fairwork Project](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSgHrOzAVpdXapu80-WblepoBY_Xm0bCZYdRIv0Mu3FJIWlstqpIukANd87TvFVsrhGqQmc1oRPhYeWw-s6ysNznjGIPltjbyRWFB) (spun out of the Oxford Internet Institute and the Berlin Social Science Center WZB). They evaluate online remote digital labor platforms (cloudwork) across five core principles of fairness: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEB6zswFSE2USaGHfykY5UHUz5nSPktY1mMfFiyzIqy5ovf_4cMsQ1W7tyk56Q9vR_jMyRvHNQ9mrE8uYtyDzlU-8RfRsO9aqVv4lF8TEaAoTaSulil2jPRL-hFARicqEIx5nVH-noqpEqDbBvl1r7caNcyi6LRgd5HUGg3cUTPDMS1XgOYjA8k1p8-ogVkY9klm0NGFg78L8NLk7YfT0TQ6gs0u36_RXS1txY), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSgHrOzAVpdXapu80-WblepoBY_Xm0bCZYdRIv0Mu3FJIWlstqpIukANd87TvFVsrhGqQmc1oRPhYeWw-s6ysNznjGIPltjbyRWFB), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]

* Fair Pay: Ensuring workers earn a wage proportional to local or national minimum standards after costs.
* Fair Conditions: Protecting workers from digital hazards, health risks (e.g., burnout, back pain), and unsafe environments.
* Fair Contracts: Providing clear, transparent terms without blanket liability clauses or vague job descriptions.
* Fair Management: Offering due process, grievance channels, freedom from arbitrary deactivation, and anti-discrimination measures.
* Fair Representation: Recognizing and engaging with workers' collective voice, freedom of association, and potential for collective bargaining. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVWyseHcrOgeLYqeuVaciIbT2Bl2gheegz8O49fNCFxbxYdR5T7ur7dv2HNN_kFwj7pw73hWUnh9o4u5T3fXX1phCrChePJl7YO6f9pl7sQaeX5KLnBxSyuitR0c4RqA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVmT_5Cq28BhzXXpWWhw_NsRR2M1YeqnnaJ63ypIhP5p_TYGYEzHEc_LXvWbJOtW7j2k__TFM9OfJ6YMz6bqUASor1yExM9Et87zeyspdWRDF4kg81g9jcCZiBAiGY7VN8KsRgoT0tby5-10-bUUFS0CsiqZESvYBT), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]

Key Findings from Recent Reports

* Scoring Scale: Platforms are scored out of 10 points based on concrete evidence provided for each threshold. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVrtHczA8RUvhA5UzIvhfYJVNZcQzQH4v1nc9xIpI4hwqMR2y530awmU5yXnsPbAenu5LsgMVJRoiR5LectlKp69zDDWMTAUCN1Q6K55iZUihRcO2VOJf65ngLwPLSmQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]
* General Trend: Most remote and freelance cloudwork platforms struggle to meet basic fairness standards, though recent reports (such as the 2025 assessment covering 16 platforms) show incremental improvements in areas like formal recognition of the right to organize. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVmT_5Cq28BhzXXpWWhw_NsRR2M1YeqnnaJ63ypIhP5p_TYGYEzHEc_LXvWbJOtW7j2k__TFM9OfJ6YMz6bqUASor1yExM9Et87zeyspdWRDF4kg81g9jcCZiBAiGY7VN8KsRgoT0tby5-10-bUUFS0CsiqZESvYBT), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]
* Global Disparities: Workers in the Global South often face steeper challenges, lower effective compensation relative to local costs of living, and higher rates of unaddressed discrimination. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVWyseHcrOgeLYqeuVaciIbT2Bl2gheegz8O49fNCFxbxYdR5T7ur7dv2HNN_kFwj7pw73hWUnh9o4u5T3fXX1phCrChePJl7YO6f9pl7sQaeX5KLnBxSyuitR0c4RqA)]

The Partnership on AI (PAI) focuses on responsible sourcing through its workstream on Responsible Sourcing Across the Data Supply Line, which aims to improve working conditions, fair pay, and well-being for global data enrichment and annotation professionals. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHrOzAVhLF-HqgyDY2ibtzMNR6ewH3hO-GJaMf6TQcxxCokUAEnG5rOTKamVs1FUFLMD2zRY-hsMH0zOEim1Hhq4fw3A7YqViOWDQqJ3WkrI9LlpC9qGzki6dLesQYaJD7dxbg6Nzm1C7OX0UN0pFB9Eitq), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
Key Frameworks and Resources

* Responsible Sourcing of Data Enrichment Services: A foundational white paper published by PAI that examines how procurement choices impact data workers and outlines industry practices to build an ethical supply chain. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVND9eFZCGixAz3bZoO8wN8T9qrb8BmKoRzy6IulvThWyTeBETsd2J4trGMIMtbg7zYS6Y9Ja767PdiEnxPaiDR3LxVVdHsUQEgYaInf2y_RBzgujcY0fGZabmBhU5kr4hA_KEYCr1cRv9zBsjhvR2DsT46Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVFmcQ-XobG4Ddo1Uwj9nuP6v50MoC0NJZZFNYIvJmN87T4gwUvKcPdV4wKToiekCSVzQDwDw_d3pz-0lYs3A7VflUuRtetPoetJTTR9bDy_PTeCPMQIsOAxV01gMmENlmct6cACPKgIVF)]
* Vendor Engagement Guidance: Practical tools to help AI developers have more accountable conversations with downstream vendors regarding worker treatment and contract terms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
* Transparency Template: A standard outlining what companies should actively monitor and publicly report about their data enrichment operations. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
* Data Enrichment Sourcing Guidelines & Checklists: Shareable resources—including the Good Instructions Checklist and vendor comparison templates—designed to operationalize worker-centric standards. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEB6zswFcmZkTtYbzCA9zH2osAMKR_j-Iiu7d_b9Ld_CkffQco1ST2-pKSq3yfrGCDoha4HKXRnFsbr3cXXh8gKD5z6nyCEgS_rnLA76ossU_DbJBHd2Z9ihpoQ3E8L6ONaZyCdO9jR-qwBXba1PTsjr_q6APTT8ZmH1jKDdTU8XiKBr7cbBuRllyOjRFw1mmq55pGQKaJoofkeIns9OxzvcCt1VK4)]

Real-World Implementation

* DeepMind Collaboration: PAI partnered with Google DeepMind to test and put these responsible sourcing recommendations into operational practice, sharing lessons learned to help other AI organizations raise standards across the industry. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVZ9hzdvGoFuVTV7gTFhG86AR5uDnJY3wi5ilH7QV-n2R6X5vrF8RH-diU5rt4dkK6Mzo28ei88Z-zL_u0CXLpckNCfr7hchlZONkKRgnye3L1rh8dC04pymqKlQnxaHpCbolMyrkd4gwwfMkmbU_9ssJQaw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVjwkAM8M4WzQceYJFLyQmDpVCSyxnUdjvcvXXHA97v_BWieBiHfslPU-1kbHVTFE5TyPZNlvbxD7iznnDk89tONIy_aEaNJaSCHgPG24Ich5w5V7Blcng2dU9EDkrFQ)]

The [Coworker.org Bossware and Employment Tech Database](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVEvr5fP2qQFkcDJb1eLdl701B6pP0ma8N9pi9GAQF413qwEULfWshIHh9ORYdPoR7RN42K5b_zvy8SX1bAQpSBnktY_Oe8Lv6WvQLIr2Yki3PgFY4VEk) catalogs more than 550 labor-focused technology products used to monitor, track, and manage workers across various industries. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVEvr5fP2qQFkcDJb1eLdl701B6pP0ma8N9pi9GAQF413qwEULfWshIHh9ORYdPoR7RN42K5b_zvy8SX1bAQpSBnktY_Oe8Lv6WvQLIr2Yki3PgFY4VEk)]
What is Bossware?
"Bossware" refers to software and digital tools that managers use to supervise employee habits, outputs, physical locations, and biometrics. Common features include: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEB6zswFS0-snMTwcg4NpgoMLj2V4Ea6xuE2BoqDEdUvY6WUVOulYKikvVb1rTZF5gjUgyQjxMaI6v1BfVKQmXFmkRxLe20HJGeYUSu1_nOK1V67XokFDVdSNBssbA2V2uWeNX1MOl16HM73KfBWnRJxJwMPp_UUk4CdTivU2M5YSv1Wz_fs76r8g)]

* Activity Tracking: Logging keystrokes, mouse movements, active window focus, and app or website usage. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV5tkP6OC1JbBCjQ27X-30JNlXuashIscJz3iC4vjxZxnWb8cucZacml5aFem5bYbgI72LKZEb8hPn3cE5tVmk0swvmx36CYT-4_ywib3r9DCbw2UU2s3a9KMCbeuZmB4QsrQE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVFtGFR7wsbcmhqcb32icrqai1hKTCTiQEb04PHH-doP0F2qGCFWoXdEuc7FF2J_ZL4VQ1_5XqfhZx-gFVVn_nxO7k3WSOcKGx2-In88XZs4lRGoNr0htmGiTsYD85)]
* Visual Monitoring: Taking periodic or continuous screenshots and recording webcams. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVFtGFR7wsbcmhqcb32icrqai1hKTCTiQEb04PHH-doP0F2qGCFWoXdEuc7FF2J_ZL4VQ1_5XqfhZx-gFVVn_nxO7k3WSOcKGx2-In88XZs4lRGoNr0htmGiTsYD85), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV5tkP6OC1JbBCjQ27X-30JNlXuashIscJz3iC4vjxZxnWb8cucZacml5aFem5bYbgI72LKZEb8hPn3cE5tVmk0swvmx36CYT-4_ywib3r9DCbw2UU2s3a9KMCbeuZmB4QsrQE)]
* Location & Biometrics: Tracking real-time GPS locations, facial recognition, or physical movement metrics. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVUHYEx-lV6_aYvQVA9eV7JVfh8iraMoIm_3K8EWHTOC6zyaee48OyLMVwYh9FYLGIIXv9ozX-_xuqaVjU0l8yNUA63OahxBTOjghpoH3axgsUu-tTiTjvUY0Ca1M7), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVEvr5fP2qQFkcDJb1eLdl701B6pP0ma8N9pi9GAQF413qwEULfWshIHh9ORYdPoR7RN42K5b_zvy8SX1bAQpSBnktY_Oe8Lv6WvQLIr2Yki3PgFY4VEk)]
* Productivity Scoring: Generating automated daily scores or flagged alerts for "productive" versus "unproductive" behavior. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxwEB6zswFSE8JHQhAgqEjHzXEc_tAVYFLpak-BYfhaxcAFb8DzmPFc0x-aUtplN_4YL49sEjALWVLvqsWJqJeC-NjWzWstfLWF8Nq324FxWeGdi2h4NQXyrKd9mPfGYW3ggpY95k_1v75KKdTVyAkznBa2JJutZZGPlmt3TsmXuVBdF7kZCX34cc9NOnOQZZjd7i94FSLZGEWO0GbUet2wINKudR3f1B5ggvQa17i1Pp9wvE-9JckIyxZcBebqiOL6xYLekqcQ5x), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV5tkP6OC1JbBCjQ27X-30JNlXuashIscJz3iC4vjxZxnWb8cucZacml5aFem5bYbgI72LKZEb8hPn3cE5tVmk0swvmx36CYT-4_ywib3r9DCbw2UU2s3a9KMCbeuZmB4QsrQE)]

Key Database Examples
The [Coworker Worktech Database](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVEvr5fP2qQFkcDJb1eLdl701B6pP0ma8N9pi9GAQF413qwEULfWshIHh9ORYdPoR7RN42K5b_zvy8SX1bAQpSBnktY_Oe8Lv6WvQLIr2Yki3PgFY4VEk) tracks a wide range of platforms across categories: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVEvr5fP2qQFkcDJb1eLdl701B6pP0ma8N9pi9GAQF413qwEULfWshIHh9ORYdPoR7RN42K5b_zvy8SX1bAQpSBnktY_Oe8Lv6WvQLIr2Yki3PgFY4VEk)]

* Productivity & Monitoring Software: ActivTrak, Hubstaff, Time Doctor, Desklog, and Controlio. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVEvr5fP2qQFkcDJb1eLdl701B6pP0ma8N9pi9GAQF413qwEULfWshIHh9ORYdPoR7RN42K5b_zvy8SX1bAQpSBnktY_Oe8Lv6WvQLIr2Yki3PgFY4VEk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEB6zswFVa21XY9ZhOP6Te1ET-d17IJuVUeUWbDkkYagTPz9o7VbTrGZdOYa-O8twfioQvoK9IpgMBMLIJehifquvYtWl8kPIJo4_lrm_pSTETP4xDt1Blxi3ASMcCae_1vlQoFDsJYPkv-X7nCrowKZaFw5-avfRp79LpYIH-vkrs8MI7qWZ7ylXq_hRJnUPov8be_), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVudb3HhE81_C8In65UNOHsKsrIySzrq9Xyh1h_hYdEPmTTMw2XAFiJeNlsHvFC0eV75fJI3rA4KuYwrkl_Z6Pxh6pUE21efj2PydC0U6r6dTdfRsGLCgmdaYuCM839URYyYNiIA)]

[Worker Info Exchange](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI) is a non-profit organization based in London (operating also as Stichting WIE International) that fights for the digital and labor rights of gig economy workers. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVDWF1xryrobc8zKIHIlUAyKOBdxRzHp9-V5imS6Z5bSq0jMYw6DQlXYssonIo_NO9TH9gq3F1GhEmHkaJWKdVE5aszx47Oi-GyWyPEvtH35rh)]
Key Mission & Work

* Data Control: Helps gig workers use data access and Subject Access Requests (SARs) to see how tech platforms track pay, work allocation, and performance. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI)]
* Algorithmic Accountability: Investigates and challenges unfair management practices, automated dismissals, and dynamic pricing or pay systems. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVDWF1xryrobc8zKIHIlUAyKOBdxRzHp9-V5imS6Z5bSq0jMYw6DQlXYssonIo_NO9TH9gq3F1GhEmHkaJWKdVE5aszx47Oi-GyWyPEvtH35rh), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI)]
* Collective Legal Action: Coordinates group lawsuits against major platforms like Uber—such as collective claims challenging dynamic pay systems that reduce driver earnings and increase hidden commissions. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVDWF1xryrobc8zKIHIlUAyKOBdxRzHp9-V5imS6Z5bSq0jMYw6DQlXYssonIo_NO9TH9gq3F1GhEmHkaJWKdVE5aszx47Oi-GyWyPEvtH35rh)]
* Research & Alliances: Partners with academic institutions like the University of Oxford and labor bodies (such as the TUC) to publish landmark research exposing the real-world impact of platform algorithms on workers. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESwQEB6zswFQsmgbt9DMIzhJq4jpinZFNA6LbrdTKGK1uIHzsa_Fd-mbEsC9i6pSI_7Gv4X5BeWh5Ntr0dN6xNxOw9xrQzmnld5iZDaNOZEbMjUjMLtd4HA5i_D1EYBZndiEjVhmHf0dndxu6t0wBajZfnXCK2749tnBhGGuL-B9Ycp5LVY11SSthaxM2ryKHZqI9CCj9xREQQ8B3DFrOWyo08l_1V6E0OVWBFev0l5pqLcx5QvDZZ8tAJ_D2T8pgdnr2I), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxwEB6zswFYqhrosFrttu6V8VaxmMyTSUBFKLRd1VOZwE-Noza5d7afdLwzlo2ifB6bk0zVGDAlZcrY3S6s2KOkDwhgqYOKe_CxurZl_w9dTGL5g6MLhysTHwCt_8SkoHrQR8Z7iQxig1p01x-BY_0DgieA7uXTazzXOKaqFiWm6qBqE64Rm8M8OBfAgdZacZeg5hoaFUyoNiboFtPX_EQ7XEquztFV_sPjTiBKYTFyWrPlo7XWo-H7BQYSAqUW7qtJFyEabsq-al)]

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVMzivhh8Fx5LPsPYXFR5ge-9peJ4YrM1aIISl2yIvE357_4MAstTXc8GJa_VQyeGp1Wh0rFO_LxXVtDz9-9mmML5_U5YbB0aQHUdol0zdh0NQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEB6zswFYd3sAdAYMs3YdPGrqcmfvVRVnS59wEtI5F4H2muDhNtagfBjM3eKlTvBwo6bA2y9ie-bHXqA0gVN1UG9Pdd90u1nDXeawjAIofYWT4Lelg5tuJQHtRnU94zagDx2CotgVwacFAqwPk8Sh7-6_dV5aMd-Vl2FKT24T5sFxyGme-cufnlbnTxWvevmnZbFmfhIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxAEB6zswFRfsmthFwKWaCO8Kz20zYVWWWAcffd4zNM5wdPxmbqGfPtqNjBjBOGUMygtMhLOT5svXxLDdtMAu8hS8QkI31TwjZJ1nOXZ950dzjxsqmq5QnSs4GkxN1FZl1Suyz_5DpTxboMaaw8MQ8jo2O-jgDLy78kFJSqeXtLbW8LSW5XMK0m0hoDD1evlFjdfMKOru0bJZE3zi_m3mu5VU5IjW5JslFctxlC_-J6CxmGTPI0e0MH5WYq3cgYT7m1E06Vs-)]
Key Features of the Tracker

* Global Coverage: Tracks policy developments, laws, and agreements across more than 30 countries (including Australia, China, Italy, the United States, and others). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVMzivhh8Fx5LPsPYXFR5ge-9peJ4YrM1aIISl2yIvE357_4MAstTXc8GJa_VQyeGp1Wh0rFO_LxXVtDz9-9mmML5_U5YbB0aQHUdol0zdh0NQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxAEB6zswFRfsmthFwKWaCO8Kz20zYVWWWAcffd4zNM5wdPxmbqGfPtqNjBjBOGUMygtMhLOT5svXxLDdtMAu8hS8QkI31TwjZJ1nOXZ950dzjxsqmq5QnSs4GkxN1FZl1Suyz_5DpTxboMaaw8MQ8jo2O-jgDLy78kFJSqeXtLbW8LSW5XMK0m0hoDD1evlFjdfMKOru0bJZE3zi_m3mu5VU5IjW5JslFctxlC_-J6CxmGTPI0e0MH5WYq3cgYT7m1E06Vs-)]
* Core Issues Monitored:
   * Employment status classification
   * Remuneration and fair pay
   * Algorithms and automated decision-making
   * Working time
   * Privacy and data protection
   * Occupational safety and health (OSH)
   * Contract termination and account deactivation
   * Collective bargaining [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEB6zswFYd3sAdAYMs3YdPGrqcmfvVRVnS59wEtI5F4H2muDhNtagfBjM3eKlTvBwo6bA2y9ie-bHXqA0gVN1UG9Pdd90u1nDXeawjAIofYWT4Lelg5tuJQHtRnU94zagDx2CotgVwacFAqwPk8Sh7-6_dV5aMd-Vl2FKT24T5sFxyGme-cufnlbnTxWvevmnZbFmfhIw)]
* Target Audience: Built for governments, employers' and workers' representatives, policymakers, and researchers to support evidence-based policymaking. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEB6zswFYd3sAdAYMs3YdPGrqcmfvVRVnS59wEtI5F4H2muDhNtagfBjM3eKlTvBwo6bA2y9ie-bHXqA0gVN1UG9Pdd90u1nDXeawjAIofYWT4Lelg5tuJQHtRnU94zagDx2CotgVwacFAqwPk8Sh7-6_dV5aMd-Vl2FKT24T5sFxyGme-cufnlbnTxWvevmnZbFmfhIw)]

The [Anthropic Economic Index](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw) is an ongoing research initiative by Anthropic that tracks how individuals, enterprises, and economies use the Claude AI model. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESrQEB6zswFeM_cNzkPhJk8ragR3JffNjzKadq8YHBPx5HIEWjwjp_fz5K3nNe3huzzAWQcCF1ddjNRC1Z8SDHqjN5ep7lJDHyFJy7_QlY4zQ1TXY6hxEp0U-wXDN_fbWZl6Ez4GItZbnkzW4GuhkEtvo2rGQXPlL5RDgw7WNfhFFGPBSTH1Tn-xZaoT_snybDk7IKKD0a_0iT0wnIsc9KEk2FYYfllaUols2xQGEmrQ)]
Key Concepts & Components

* Economic Primitives: The index breaks down AI interactions using core metrics like task complexity, required human skills, use case (work, personal, or coursework), AI autonomy (delegation vs. collaboration), and task reliability/success rate. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVRWl92HHoU_f4ehaqDEPn4046g7VW6zkY3Al8Yq3ppqO6d_NjxEI_mMVY9JsDL6j7SzmDkl5bBED1fdlIwH8L4cJ5asByhhjjMbwsu0oAEQ90nWfto13QuInzhLpsrA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV6GV44gX4-sl0rt4m6EaQsJH8Nh4K4BsN1_juJve7LhimLJhXBIQ9y36r7Im6UruwOP5JagzQVm70XMCMZDx_XdBAFLcxFzgpdt4X_pAfQ90CZWl9YuLWw5V6uY8vng), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw)]
* Augmentation vs. Automation: Research shows that most consumer usage leans toward augmentation (collaborative "thinking partner" interactions like iterative editing, learning, and validation) rather than complete delegation or full automation. However, enterprise API users increasingly use Claude for specialized, automated workflows. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFc5pXwWQAbGgSADZauXFgL9hFIWouAK4CtZKmGBoyk9IS4Qw-393LTw0xwc6QnnIwR8gqZIBkIYoNrgDbIpL8q8QoomefPVVbwou4l7wR444h7Ig4XwTIZ3md1oGlji7aNfjq2wFsfy0JzTTawgFVJQWfIWzkalLDsQTRw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVRWl92HHoU_f4ehaqDEPn4046g7VW6zkY3Al8Yq3ppqO6d_NjxEI_mMVY9JsDL6j7SzmDkl5bBED1fdlIwH8L4cJ5asByhhjjMbwsu0oAEQ90nWfto13QuInzhLpsrA)]
* Geographic & Economic Disparities: Usage is heavily concentrated in high-income nations (such as Australia, Switzerland, Luxembourg, and the United States) and tech-forward urban centers relative to population size. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFfO7w_1WAnSZ4wgfDW5LS24WqxhvdAnKy14mX-DUDkEWuaFopnBHwxstZZ55nIy0raARuDjGDH7MBR2GZDA3AKRnojhgV7LWy9yP-BulbeDt1rQBnqHUAi6DhXe8Z5TR_dTO8I7sF2Ag9G_kFhHAwZtGH9iF1v45lWVDBcYvoJL2_cVcUUisblV5C5HJG5i4-byBmYk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI)]
* Top Industries & Job Types: Technical and analytical roles—such as computer and mathematical occupations, arts and media, and educational instruction—lead in volume and concentration of usage. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw)]
* Interactive Tool: Anthropic provides open datasets and an in-app Claude connector that lets users query the index data directly in plain language. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVooMtJDuZl5WbLc0Klfizh5ZHJYjGpz7ftBw9Wwrd7bLdxP6AcCMlr4s1exbSBkr6JwB4ZrTRBiYVtn3dn_8z5w6mvJfEf4bZak1m2oR560MeA6iTy3frDQrw2XvQlI896zK-), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI)]

The [Anthropic Economic Index](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw) is an ongoing research initiative by Anthropic that tracks how individuals, enterprises, and economies use the Claude AI model. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESrQEB6zswFeM_cNzkPhJk8ragR3JffNjzKadq8YHBPx5HIEWjwjp_fz5K3nNe3huzzAWQcCF1ddjNRC1Z8SDHqjN5ep7lJDHyFJy7_QlY4zQ1TXY6hxEp0U-wXDN_fbWZl6Ez4GItZbnkzW4GuhkEtvo2rGQXPlL5RDgw7WNfhFFGPBSTH1Tn-xZaoT_snybDk7IKKD0a_0iT0wnIsc9KEk2FYYfllaUols2xQGEmrQ)]
Key Concepts & Components

* Economic Primitives: The index breaks down AI interactions using core metrics like task complexity, required human skills, use case (work, personal, or coursework), AI autonomy (delegation vs. collaboration), and task reliability/success rate. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVRWl92HHoU_f4ehaqDEPn4046g7VW6zkY3Al8Yq3ppqO6d_NjxEI_mMVY9JsDL6j7SzmDkl5bBED1fdlIwH8L4cJ5asByhhjjMbwsu0oAEQ90nWfto13QuInzhLpsrA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV6GV44gX4-sl0rt4m6EaQsJH8Nh4K4BsN1_juJve7LhimLJhXBIQ9y36r7Im6UruwOP5JagzQVm70XMCMZDx_XdBAFLcxFzgpdt4X_pAfQ90CZWl9YuLWw5V6uY8vng), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw)]
* Augmentation vs. Automation: Research shows that most consumer usage leans toward augmentation (collaborative "thinking partner" interactions like iterative editing, learning, and validation) rather than complete delegation or full automation. However, enterprise API users increasingly use Claude for specialized, automated workflows. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFc5pXwWQAbGgSADZauXFgL9hFIWouAK4CtZKmGBoyk9IS4Qw-393LTw0xwc6QnnIwR8gqZIBkIYoNrgDbIpL8q8QoomefPVVbwou4l7wR444h7Ig4XwTIZ3md1oGlji7aNfjq2wFsfy0JzTTawgFVJQWfIWzkalLDsQTRw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVRWl92HHoU_f4ehaqDEPn4046g7VW6zkY3Al8Yq3ppqO6d_NjxEI_mMVY9JsDL6j7SzmDkl5bBED1fdlIwH8L4cJ5asByhhjjMbwsu0oAEQ90nWfto13QuInzhLpsrA)]
* Geographic & Economic Disparities: Usage is heavily concentrated in high-income nations (such as Australia, Switzerland, Luxembourg, and the United States) and tech-forward urban centers relative to population size. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEB6zswFfO7w_1WAnSZ4wgfDW5LS24WqxhvdAnKy14mX-DUDkEWuaFopnBHwxstZZ55nIy0raARuDjGDH7MBR2GZDA3AKRnojhgV7LWy9yP-BulbeDt1rQBnqHUAi6DhXe8Z5TR_dTO8I7sF2Ag9G_kFhHAwZtGH9iF1v45lWVDBcYvoJL2_cVcUUisblV5C5HJG5i4-byBmYk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI)]
* Top Industries & Job Types: Technical and analytical roles—such as computer and mathematical occupations, arts and media, and educational instruction—lead in volume and concentration of usage. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVpqMALvM3UIUXUg59XXExO8qPRTUqJPesFUyo_Q5wvx4Idkm5IaAGzgHuXoUZh_QpYPe7yijJXDRqay64LOgXKi3GNy7aL3nA8vI56qWgtBW-BBZxyf9ae9upaKtEGUsOrK_2zxeelw)]
* Interactive Tool: Anthropic provides open datasets and an in-app Claude connector that lets users query the index data directly in plain language. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVooMtJDuZl5WbLc0Klfizh5ZHJYjGpz7ftBw9Wwrd7bLdxP6AcCMlr4s1exbSBkr6JwB4ZrTRBiYVtn3dn_8z5w6mvJfEf4bZak1m2oR560MeA6iTy3frDQrw2XvQlI896zK-), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVi6UX1VSz9yP0rq9RqGd224fPta9PTPOrBQEUilVkpavvxOkcWnvFJR7RMUhfKjEN3uEPABwJ7PbI-xa-4pLgBy6iVyyV2K3T2iejsv0VKp36wkXqpDHL7QMyIw), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVeC_635u1TvXLUJYk_jzCU2TXQaWZ-7ejMxgBZ8I9G_KEZMLXFydGisljYguO220vMFAmM54Ry5kLIsVCcbuZPmzzVPweYaOYaOZmWu9i-CyAwQI)]

GDPval is an AI benchmark created by [OpenAI](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg) to measure how well artificial intelligence models perform on real-world, economically valuable knowledge-work tasks rather than academic or math tests. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAV5e1D92fjl4arLGgbWubPM_woQLTk88wKqtsjeycDpo4ugmHlLKBY2Jmgp8L30J-U1cjOBDae-FiGJbaIH7bL25Gw_j2LadpPeqBjk_YuRdt18qQ), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV9ofAr51RKj_rQOL_JfwndrUjbdpvWVx4myclZBWUACpQsLQQr7iFpEKr_duZsBLrpkrlAoqbGGtym3eGY9RndTjy_G59i1bkd9_MPHYhOve8DUZHKa5q2sD_cYLYHw)]
Key Details

* Scope: Covers 1,320 specialized tasks across 44 occupations derived from the top 9 U.S. GDP-contributing sectors. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESggEB6zswFe2tOqXCoWJa8bALG0Q6O5sjAYGmf7a-oLxpTbJ5qcxu6is-NOEdLzyAP_TIRy2vrAjnFfnuluIIeOfIEfPV872RvaFirwwF_vUZXYXjICql23SYvHpMv7sZFHmkLHVIVYJzczNBsFmwduVAWTTPIgCcWPq2-FHAEQuna1nC), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg)]
* Task Design: Built by industry professionals with an average of 14 years of experience using actual work products like legal briefs, spreadsheets, and engineering blueprints. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEB6zswFdiU5v-2bvjveGnb5VRaIqHJGLAx1zx-bqb3KsbzMazsgASe6Zy4djwyaLew68L1JAn-FDVpHmeQc3N_-X86VuIb26GT8zxguER68zFWXuHizxS4XvKq1frf8xehgvnN49PX29xVueyA3NAeYTJX9ilMrDsgnSZTq7lfGlU), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg)]
* Evaluation: Uses blind head-to-head comparisons by human experts to grade model outputs against human work. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVhPUzkeZH77Ag5jLMmksSXvMZIZn3Sp_gF5kA_w6WuRy05O9W5aaR91vp2mcMDj0LP6Z6Dh3R6CNeLyRGrDRztzxt5b0SrhXSwBWUrWI8BUM3oPg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESggEB6zswFe2tOqXCoWJa8bALG0Q6O5sjAYGmf7a-oLxpTbJ5qcxu6is-NOEdLzyAP_TIRy2vrAjnFfnuluIIeOfIEfPV872RvaFirwwF_vUZXYXjICql23SYvHpMv7sZFHmkLHVIVYJzczNBsFmwduVAWTTPIgCcWPq2-FHAEQuna1nC)]
* Open Source Set: Includes a gold open-sourced subset of 220 tasks available via [Hugging Face Datasets](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVm5FY12OrrM0U6PSxauyQdUwzN8-8rk1Z-9EU8DSkpEJyiaghIjM8OUDTTTwYY9F3FOr1suUN7D-RQdFC44Y8DZqzlNkNd4_3MEsmBpgPdNQl0PKHVzYpyxlHs1qyhSgQ) and detailed in the [ArXiv Research Paper](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAV5e1D92fjl4arLGgbWubPM_woQLTk88wKqtsjeycDpo4ugmHlLKBY2Jmgp8L30J-U1cjOBDae-FiGJbaIH7bL25Gw_j2LadpPeqBjk_YuRdt18qQ). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVm5FY12OrrM0U6PSxauyQdUwzN8-8rk1Z-9EU8DSkpEJyiaghIjM8OUDTTTwYY9F3FOr1suUN7D-RQdFC44Y8DZqzlNkNd4_3MEsmBpgPdNQl0PKHVzYpyxlHs1qyhSgQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAV5e1D92fjl4arLGgbWubPM_woQLTk88wKqtsjeycDpo4ugmHlLKBY2Jmgp8L30J-U1cjOBDae-FiGJbaIH7bL25Gw_j2LadpPeqBjk_YuRdt18qQ)]
* Leaderboards: Evaluated by frameworks like [Artificial Analysis GDPval-AA v2.1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVgAjm8sR1LVSiS9i7GzX2qM_VLeqRumJBavESmc8WxlV73ea4yA7gFz_me9eppW0Og-Ml_WxAMVWD3bWEpsY0O2plbNqtIGV7xMNVdQ7190-HFX_X5hjx_vrKAGEnxHNh9xe-HRA4). A "canary in a coal mine" is an early warning sign or indicator of hidden danger, trouble, or failure. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVEqRzLnZhV5mcWA7F_hu8yR8AcWPyxWvFaKw3jfarHSB8vnYaKGaK6j36zRikDdgt_7KM9X1QbNsZaMLy8KX2Li7tH5GCczZ4JahVHGbZKis6QUBGipyTJFWarekt9Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
Historical Origin

* Toxic gas detection: In the late 19th and 20th centuries, coal miners brought caged canaries into underground tunnels. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVH1drH5NI4jXNCYpOPyKxfv1305tVWQ86XWSovAFqRfU2V8S85Kbxq3Y1UhfLBMkMzEX1dsL-qNm79T9oMWjw1GtXVXutW8gLkicuZeV3aK4fztuccKcsmHN0taTv), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVa_5SekDXQbkaCZ8gmIC4BtGeH3ADFaiopOiykFS4cyJtZXmmT6FFn7kvoSgOMG2LmFIaJXaKOjJ5ZehBnpms5iknHbqaHx5JlP6anx4QwbnDjnHG6Dxd1ln6Tr2OYw)]
* Physiology: Canaries have a rapid breathing rate and high metabolism, making them much more sensitive to lethal, odorless gases like carbon monoxide and methane than humans. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEB6zswFSO5H75EU10vINs9SOmfnxiaGnrN_H3H4Z4DkU39fNQYFj0FEoMOKoEDKoSYteMEFaPB5qi0mY5Sn36b6tCUfUNPKNREcQUGBmXD8D5rTd9lc6pP12KHq7grmiuglVJE0zMGK2-35Iul72rBV24Nb0QY0C57oVYZGR_K2eCAkLKJmtRxUUM1DXxx2gPyXJ1S6A), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAES2AEB6zswFcFG8Oa3_RCjdVIHPuTOJ8mwMQLAnWielJU9GovMM5khTG3tNwWqDPfdMkesFgPui4ggrEUxa8D03kfIAWTQNJo6pCniVKc5Ud_hhqllV8daNccEeeBkm6jy0Z9lad5DiwRfMl-wvzy4tSH0bhDTsg4cuECHOUuNUE6QaYyQnGePhWldSCP74MrFzMA6oZnyWGoNZMeJVNMW-EDStZG_sf1KhnRToqf7Vr1wVL5FUnq3_YUru7d4eFcod1qtteGP4lXBo7LEIg597JfqDlk60Ni2x2I)]
* The warning signal: As long as the bird sang and acted normally, the air was safe. If the canary grew distressed, fell silent, or collapsed, it signaled that poisonous gas was building up and miners needed to escape. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVTOpgmdrF8RpGKlFLXDfKJ023XeBlxSYaHGsLb5N_KtiDD_h0IMyn0uZNSMAH_--vKuqO9RcgMBkW3a2BcjMkuuIC7KWZNx8lqVWWhENFHOXscc8VtTmlV3mL9raewBBfrbcW), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFT9qJXl1mov9iH0FSD06go8edvUa1sPoh-j4oPaiZnr8gOVUZ_aA-edkzAQNg1AMRQQOqriZrjBpJ8HOfCDIwMuH5BPWKzxKCYQc-ut0AogTcTe8PvrxyGTJZy4BSPY6iNdbcQVXWS71b1AceLAVjFtqOs1Z4PxeYRg_-7QBKQcnTz3rv9OjeH9FFkwLs6PUzt9_jI-dfwqlkk92m6U), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVH1drH5NI4jXNCYpOPyKxfv1305tVWQ86XWSovAFqRfU2V8S85Kbxq3Y1UhfLBMkMzEX1dsL-qNm79T9oMWjw1GtXVXutW8gLkicuZeV3aK4fztuccKcsmHN0taTv)]
* Replacement: The practice continued until electronic gas detectors replaced live birds in the late 20th century (around 1996). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVw9cH-m4LMwad3zjiP3B4hA79l243daKPbJdHGCC_f6oam843iAmtOiZllECSVPCs9NrnimN8V7HSVcn--MCpxQjFkKS0E2yo9l7nEiDNREeeXZXB_pzBXhRTJWRMlrpx0o05ZQufROpIobtculxefg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVTOpgmdrF8RpGKlFLXDfKJ023XeBlxSYaHGsLb5N_KtiDD_h0IMyn0uZNSMAH_--vKuqO9RcgMBkW3a2BcjMkuuIC7KWZNx8lqVWWhENFHOXscc8VtTmlV3mL9raewBBfrbcW)]

Modern Idiom & Metaphor
Today, the phrase describes anything that breaks down or shows negative changes first during a larger crisis: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVw9cH-m4LMwad3zjiP3B4hA79l243daKPbJdHGCC_f6oam843iAmtOiZllECSVPCs9NrnimN8V7HSVcn--MCpxQjFkKS0E2yo9l7nEiDNREeeXZXB_pzBXhRTJWRMlrpx0o05ZQufROpIobtculxefg)]

* Economics: Declining hotel occupancy or airport traffic used as an early sign of an incoming economic downturn. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
* Environment: Melting glaciers, dying coral reefs, or disappearing insects used as early warnings for climate change and ecosystem stress. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVEqRzLnZhV5mcWA7F_hu8yR8AcWPyxWvFaKw3jfarHSB8vnYaKGaK6j36zRikDdgt_7KM9X1QbNsZaMLy8KX2Li7tH5GCczZ4JahVHGbZKis6QUBGipyTJFWarekt9Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
* Technology & Labor: Studies such as the [Stanford Digital Economy Lab](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEB6zswFfWR09Ro4231Ymf6sqMG9zJt7dFxoNTpKPKnikT5ywAVg9Aqfb9SSURLIlLADj7qvuNW6ia3tcW9jcckyANjv2P9J6HhS_OYAnlWXeKBGYy8lUCIlAQZRVJcKozP5OvAP_TBzBBr4YBQAZQd3nzXkpMPRW9Wbuy3jCQHRx22P806YwiGsVeRSx5BDJ6IPFWprzuOpHU21vfwnLVlz0xaWfThHUKLMMUxnpUn4HdhfvnNJVz1jP2L3akkP6gbePN5br7YQZ1nadI) report tracking entry-level or young worker employment shifts as early indicators of artificial intelligence impacts on the job market. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEB6zswFfWR09Ro4231Ymf6sqMG9zJt7dFxoNTpKPKnikT5ywAVg9Aqfb9SSURLIlLADj7qvuNW6ia3tcW9jcckyANjv2P9J6HhS_OYAnlWXeKBGYy8lUCIlAQZRVJcKozP5OvAP_TBzBBr4YBQAZQd3nzXkpMPRW9Wbuy3jCQHRx22P806YwiGsVeRSx5BDJ6IPFWprzuOpHU21vfwnLVlz0xaWfThHUKLMMUxnpUn4HdhfvnNJVz1jP2L3akkP6gbePN5br7YQZ1nadI)]

A "canary in a coal mine" is an early warning sign or indicator of hidden danger, trouble, or failure. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVEqRzLnZhV5mcWA7F_hu8yR8AcWPyxWvFaKw3jfarHSB8vnYaKGaK6j36zRikDdgt_7KM9X1QbNsZaMLy8KX2Li7tH5GCczZ4JahVHGbZKis6QUBGipyTJFWarekt9Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
Historical Origin

* Toxic gas detection: In the late 19th and 20th centuries, coal miners brought caged canaries into underground tunnels. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVH1drH5NI4jXNCYpOPyKxfv1305tVWQ86XWSovAFqRfU2V8S85Kbxq3Y1UhfLBMkMzEX1dsL-qNm79T9oMWjw1GtXVXutW8gLkicuZeV3aK4fztuccKcsmHN0taTv), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVa_5SekDXQbkaCZ8gmIC4BtGeH3ADFaiopOiykFS4cyJtZXmmT6FFn7kvoSgOMG2LmFIaJXaKOjJ5ZehBnpms5iknHbqaHx5JlP6anx4QwbnDjnHG6Dxd1ln6Tr2OYw)]
* Physiology: Canaries have a rapid breathing rate and high metabolism, making them much more sensitive to lethal, odorless gases like carbon monoxide and methane than humans. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEB6zswFSO5H75EU10vINs9SOmfnxiaGnrN_H3H4Z4DkU39fNQYFj0FEoMOKoEDKoSYteMEFaPB5qi0mY5Sn36b6tCUfUNPKNREcQUGBmXD8D5rTd9lc6pP12KHq7grmiuglVJE0zMGK2-35Iul72rBV24Nb0QY0C57oVYZGR_K2eCAkLKJmtRxUUM1DXxx2gPyXJ1S6A), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAES2AEB6zswFcFG8Oa3_RCjdVIHPuTOJ8mwMQLAnWielJU9GovMM5khTG3tNwWqDPfdMkesFgPui4ggrEUxa8D03kfIAWTQNJo6pCniVKc5Ud_hhqllV8daNccEeeBkm6jy0Z9lad5DiwRfMl-wvzy4tSH0bhDTsg4cuECHOUuNUE6QaYyQnGePhWldSCP74MrFzMA6oZnyWGoNZMeJVNMW-EDStZG_sf1KhnRToqf7Vr1wVL5FUnq3_YUru7d4eFcod1qtteGP4lXBo7LEIg597JfqDlk60Ni2x2I)]
* The warning signal: As long as the bird sang and acted normally, the air was safe. If the canary grew distressed, fell silent, or collapsed, it signaled that poisonous gas was building up and miners needed to escape. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVTOpgmdrF8RpGKlFLXDfKJ023XeBlxSYaHGsLb5N_KtiDD_h0IMyn0uZNSMAH_--vKuqO9RcgMBkW3a2BcjMkuuIC7KWZNx8lqVWWhENFHOXscc8VtTmlV3mL9raewBBfrbcW), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFT9qJXl1mov9iH0FSD06go8edvUa1sPoh-j4oPaiZnr8gOVUZ_aA-edkzAQNg1AMRQQOqriZrjBpJ8HOfCDIwMuH5BPWKzxKCYQc-ut0AogTcTe8PvrxyGTJZy4BSPY6iNdbcQVXWS71b1AceLAVjFtqOs1Z4PxeYRg_-7QBKQcnTz3rv9OjeH9FFkwLs6PUzt9_jI-dfwqlkk92m6U), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVH1drH5NI4jXNCYpOPyKxfv1305tVWQ86XWSovAFqRfU2V8S85Kbxq3Y1UhfLBMkMzEX1dsL-qNm79T9oMWjw1GtXVXutW8gLkicuZeV3aK4fztuccKcsmHN0taTv)]
* Replacement: The practice continued until electronic gas detectors replaced live birds in the late 20th century (around 1996). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVw9cH-m4LMwad3zjiP3B4hA79l243daKPbJdHGCC_f6oam843iAmtOiZllECSVPCs9NrnimN8V7HSVcn--MCpxQjFkKS0E2yo9l7nEiDNREeeXZXB_pzBXhRTJWRMlrpx0o05ZQufROpIobtculxefg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVTOpgmdrF8RpGKlFLXDfKJ023XeBlxSYaHGsLb5N_KtiDD_h0IMyn0uZNSMAH_--vKuqO9RcgMBkW3a2BcjMkuuIC7KWZNx8lqVWWhENFHOXscc8VtTmlV3mL9raewBBfrbcW)]

Modern Idiom & Metaphor
Today, the phrase describes anything that breaks down or shows negative changes first during a larger crisis: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVw9cH-m4LMwad3zjiP3B4hA79l243daKPbJdHGCC_f6oam843iAmtOiZllECSVPCs9NrnimN8V7HSVcn--MCpxQjFkKS0E2yo9l7nEiDNREeeXZXB_pzBXhRTJWRMlrpx0o05ZQufROpIobtculxefg)]

* Economics: Declining hotel occupancy or airport traffic used as an early sign of an incoming economic downturn. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
* Environment: Melting glaciers, dying coral reefs, or disappearing insects used as early warnings for climate change and ecosystem stress. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVEqRzLnZhV5mcWA7F_hu8yR8AcWPyxWvFaKw3jfarHSB8vnYaKGaK6j36zRikDdgt_7KM9X1QbNsZaMLy8KX2Li7tH5GCczZ4JahVHGbZKis6QUBGipyTJFWarekt9Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFYyvGx7Cx76Ua6EORs_JuhC-pluixBm4SEb_W34t08bvCwadkdTVL8XyPUouZozV9gAybf8JcTTKmlZbSWKejiP-joAvKTtlNzzYSfR3y4McBwdXBTYVyNFkGoHI84lhlCFEmtJkPKmtILoyvRmOUHcxLItE9jfJqUABzU1N6g)]
* Technology & Labor: Studies such as the [Stanford Digital Economy Lab](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEB6zswFfWR09Ro4231Ymf6sqMG9zJt7dFxoNTpKPKnikT5ywAVg9Aqfb9SSURLIlLADj7qvuNW6ia3tcW9jcckyANjv2P9J6HhS_OYAnlWXeKBGYy8lUCIlAQZRVJcKozP5OvAP_TBzBBr4YBQAZQd3nzXkpMPRW9Wbuy3jCQHRx22P806YwiGsVeRSx5BDJ6IPFWprzuOpHU21vfwnLVlz0xaWfThHUKLMMUxnpUn4HdhfvnNJVz1jP2L3akkP6gbePN5br7YQZ1nadI) report tracking entry-level or young worker employment shifts as early indicators of artificial intelligence impacts on the job market. segments.text:
The [AI Labor Market Tracker](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw) by The Budget Lab at Yale finds no clear evidence of large-scale or economy-wide labor market disruption from artificial intelligence. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
Key Findings

* Minimal Economy-Wide Impact: Data updated through September 2026 shows that employment, unemployment rates, and wage trends for AI-exposed workers largely mirror historical patterns and pre-AI trajectories. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEB6zswFUFOomgOgPje6vL2Nwt8kKIkyFfDa3mEgDtHijmg0AqfaZFHyY_5OLNXxZjmZg2f1iFYkhlgRT0FVbFMko_1OZFG7IHW_PRB3tyHT9y3GNiKPlbeWdaClCMAfbptvGgflRmS7pbMpFoB9hsYt0jzOOF2VM8o1XaGzWGlLdm22glsdMAre454DkigUWqONIE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* No Unusual Occupational Churn: Changes in the mix of occupations across industries (occupational churn) remain flat and show no acceleration or divergence since the late 2022 launch of ChatGPT. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEB6zswFUFOomgOgPje6vL2Nwt8kKIkyFfDa3mEgDtHijmg0AqfaZFHyY_5OLNXxZjmZg2f1iFYkhlgRT0FVbFMko_1OZFG7IHW_PRB3tyHT9y3GNiKPlbeWdaClCMAfbptvGgflRmS7pbMpFoB9hsYt0jzOOF2VM8o1XaGzWGlLdm22glsdMAre454DkigUWqONIE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* Exposed vs. Unexposed Workers: Synthetic differences-in-differences comparisons between AI-exposed and unexposed workers reveal no strong, consistent statistical footprint of AI-driven displacement, though slight volatility in unemployment growth for high-exposure groups continues to be monitored. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEB6zswFU8sZI9umZ2DaxfmwRfZr1972sBeix2wLuwOhLoUq5X1vYEdxBkdpbY8s_DfpNIyKLMl4fDJDDV2fLqLcn6KcxDk8VJa1PwFM2DzhKpRKBLfr1vqpDAsD_pgkpQJCQVat08N1HcCLCwp2tv5Gc9cRpaO2QZl88QTv4GVHfvrBdrRuMLLexFwvYc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* Capital vs. Labor: Companies cutting jobs or restructuring are generally doing so for broader macro or capital-investment reasons rather than direct workforce replacement by AI agents. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVg4dxPb7X6tGYFmXwN4kEpYjrk14__zb8lre1s8NorHsnn0T4uLoyR1SeXe1DaHaI5uG0Qf5r8aajEVbtjuuK3OQndqY_s6h9-Nw9IRgHpMs9KP05gWucXZRopwE-tw)]

Interactive Tracker Sections
You can explore the live data via the [The Budget Lab](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw), which breaks down trends into three primary areas: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]

* Occupational Churn: Tracks how fast job roles and industry composition are shifting over time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* AI Metrics: Evaluates various index measurements of AI task exposure across standard occupational classifications. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEB6zswFTsJCpN3LfkWeR8cD8dNHhJ65UXoox0P0ctL-4y_AWwGcYpRMxkwYYZOIfSIK_MK2hEwCnJ_arp7ZOxcqeHijyuQMGTcU_NePeojOiKLw9f7tkBTLs2WVfDDnAY1rsWinK4PIVf723WZByuReArXzgSURiYWLxJsg3rYLP5kqNk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESewHrOzAVIdVACqsbX8syqbHRyGuC6LUKKtyZ4pvAADg1FMzpd1j7dzdiX8dECBNSC3i514DrMancwMIBIBIyOg05WO9Qz2ldyOBaZbiuTFgJ52tcEFhsEGvr1X_a1Cu8V9g1-vLY8uxua_vpTTcvd_nAzJbExYbLVA0AJw)]
* Comparisons: Analyzes employment, wage, and unemployment trajectories of workers in high- versus low-AI exposure categories. segments.text:
The Data Workers' Inquiry is a global, participatory research initiative that empowers data labelers, content moderators, and digital platform workers to investigate and document the hidden, precarious labor behind artificial intelligence.

Core Purpose & Methodology

• Worker-Led Inquiry: Modeled after Karl Marx's 1880 Workers' Inquiry, the project uses Workers' Inquiry as a Research Methodology (WIRM).
• Epistemic Authority: Data workers act as lead community researchers rather than passive subjects, shaping their own questions and findings.
• Diverse Outputs: Findings are shared through self-directed formats such as zines, documentaries, comics, essays, podcasts, animations, and research reports.

Key Focus Areas & Issues

• Global Scope: Involves co-researchers and data workers across countries including Kenya, Venezuela, Syria, Brazil, France, Germany, Spain, Lebanon, and the UK.
• Working Conditions: Exposes systemic issues like low pay (sometimes under $1–$2 an hour), sudden platform shutdowns (such as Remotasks in Kenya), severe psychological trauma from content moderation, restrictive non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), and vague task-rejection policies.
• Data Extraction: Highlights how workers are forced to hand over sensitive personal data (such as voice recordings, facial scans, and photos of family members) with little transparency or consent.

Key Partners & Organizing

• Institutions: Spearheaded by researchers including Dr. Milagros Miceli, alongside the Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR), the Weizenbaum Institute, and TU Berlin.
• Collective Action: Supports worker-led organizing efforts, including groups like the Data Labelers Association in Kenya and the African Content Moderators Union.

segments.text:
The International Labour Organization (ILO) published its updated assessment in the report "Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure" (ILO Working Paper 140).

Key Findings of the Index

• Global Exposure Rate: About 24% (1 in 4) of global workers are in occupations with some level of exposure to generative AI (GenAI).
• Highest Exposure Category (Gradient 4): Only 3.3% of global employment falls into the highest exposure category where a large majority of tasks can be heavily impacted.
• Transformation vs. Replacement: The research emphasizes job transformation rather than widespread job elimination or mass redundancy, as very few occupations consist entirely of automatable tasks.
• Income Disparities: High-income countries (HICs) show a 34% total GenAI exposure rate, compared to just 11% in low-income countries (LICs), reflecting differences in economic structures and digital adoption.
• Gender Divide: Women are nearly twice as likely to hold jobs exposed to GenAI as men (roughly 29% vs. 16% across sampled countries), largely because women are more heavily represented in clerical, administrative, and routine information-processing roles.
• Most Exposed Occupations: Clerical support workers, administrative staff, secretaries, receptionists, data entry operators, and translators face the highest exposure.
• Least Exposed Occupations: Manual trades, construction, agriculture, and heavy manufacturing involve physical and non-routine tasks with very low GenAI exposure.

Methodology

• Task-Level Assessment: Evaluates nearly 30,000 to over 52,000 individual task data points across the International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08) framework.
• Four-Gradient Framework: Combines worker surveys, expert Delphi panel inputs, and large-scale AI assessments to categorize jobs into four distinct exposure gradients based on mean exposure scores and task variability.

• Global Exposure Rate: About 24% (1 in 4) of global workers are in occupations with some level of exposure to generative AI (GenAI).
• Highest Exposure Category (Gradient 4): Only 3.3% of global employment falls into the highest exposure category where a large majority of tasks can be heavily impacted.
• Transformation vs. Replacement: The research emphasizes job transformation rather than widespread job elimination or mass redundancy, as very few occupations consist entirely of automatable tasks.
• Income Disparities: High-income countries (HICs) show a 34% total GenAI exposure rate, compared to just 11% in low-income countries (LICs), reflecting differences in economic structures and digital adoption.
• Gender Divide: Women are nearly twice as likely to hold jobs exposed to GenAI as men (roughly 29% vs. 16% across sampled countries), largely because women are more heavily represented in clerical, administrative, and routine information-processing roles.
• Most Exposed Occupations: Clerical support workers, administrative staff, secretaries, receptionists, data entry operators, and translators face the highest exposure.
• Least Exposed Occupations: Manual trades, construction, agriculture, and heavy manufacturing involve physical and non-routine tasks with very low GenAI exposure.

Methodology

• Task-Level Assessment: Evaluates nearly 30,000 to over 52,000 individual task data points across the International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08) framework.
• Four-Gradient Framework: Combines worker surveys, expert Delphi panel inputs, and large-scale AI assessments to categorize jobs into four distinct exposure gradients based on mean exposure scores and task variability.

Negotiating a tech offer means treating the total compensation package—not just the base salary—as a flexible starting point.

Core Rules of Tech Negotiation

• Don't say a number first: Avoid sharing your current compensation or salary expectations early in the process. Ask the recruiter for the role’s budgeted band instead.
• Buy time: Never accept or reject an offer on the initial phone call. Respond neutrally with excitement, then ask to review the details in writing.
• Negotiate via email: Putting your counter-proposal in writing helps you control the message, avoid pressure, and clearly list your rationales.
• Use data sources: Research real-world compensation bands using platforms like Levels.fyi (via Tech Interview Handbook) or H-1B salary databases rather than unverified general sites.
• Understand offers won't be rescinded: Major tech companies rarely revoke an offer just because you asked for more.

What to Negotiate Beyond Base Salary

Tech companies have different degrees of flexibility depending on the lever:
• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) / Equity: Often has the most room for adjustment, especially at mid-to-senior levels where equity makes up the bulk of your total compensation.
• Sign-on Bonus: Easier for companies to approve than raising your permanent base salary. Use it to cover unvested equity or bonuses you are walking away from at your current job.
• Start Date: Time your start date to coincide with your current employer’s next stock vesting cliff to avoid leaving money on the table ("double-dipping").
• Level / Title: If you are operating at a higher scope, push for an uplevel (though this requires strong evidence or a 30-60-90 day plan).
• Non-monetary perks: Remote work flexibility, extra PTO days, or relocation assistance.

Leverage & Strategy

• Competing offers: Having another active offer is your strongest piece of leverage. Be transparent with recruiters about your interview timelines to force alignment.
• The "Reason" rule: Always back up your counter-offer with a logical rationale (e.g., total compensation alignment with market data, a competing offer, or increased responsibilities).
• Build internal advocates: Speaking with the hiring manager or skip-level manager to discuss your vision for the role can turn them into internal champions who advocate for a better offer on your behalf.
If you'd like to tailor this to your situation, tell me:
• What role/level and company type (startup vs. big tech) are you negotiating?
• Do you currently have a competing offer or unvested equity to cover?
